digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow and external integration testing
propositions: Gerrit Verify currently runs thousands of real Pandoc subprocess conversions over the complete DC wiki corpus, consuming at least 184.32 seconds of the macOS critical path.
ADR 0095 mandates every conversion assertion use the real Pandoc binary; this decision must be narrowly superseded by a new ADR to allow moving complete corpus replay to external integration.

The approved design preserves three representative live corpus test bodies and compact provenance probes in Gerrit Verify while moving complete real-Pandoc replay to a dedicated external-integration.yml job.
The external-integration.yml workflow is currently Ubuntu-only and requires implementation to add a pandoc-corpus-replay matrix with ubuntu-latest and macos-latest runners.
ADR 0096 must document the new verification boundary, preserve all production renderer invariants, and require paired A/B evidence demonstrating the actual performance improvement.
